top.t: 纽约州大选提前投票今天开始，持续到11月1日
top.s: 11月3日中期选举的提前投票从今天（10月24日）起至11月1日进行。纽约市选民须到指定的提前投票站投票，投票站可能与选举日投票站不同，出门前请先在市选举局网站查询。提前投过票的选民选举日不能再投。
top.src: New York State Board of Elections

top.t: FBI联合州市执法搜查纽约逾百家成人日间照护中心，法拉盛成焦点
top.s: 联邦、州及市府执法人员10月20日在皇后区、布碌崙、史泰登岛等地联合行动，调查社交型成人日间照护中心涉嫌白卡（Medicaid）诈骗。FBI称，2019年1月至2024年10月间州白卡为此类服务支付约24亿元。联邦医保与白卡服务中心主任奥兹亲赴法拉盛，向两家中心递交警告信。

top.t: 粮食券工作规定扩大，部分华人恐失补助
top.s: 纽约联合劝募会提醒，粮食券（SNAP）新工作规定适用范围扩大，18至64岁的部分受助人每月需证明工作、培训或义工满80小时，否则可能失去补助。收到通知者请尽快联络社会服务部门或SNAP协助机构。

local.t: 房东挑战租金冻结案，纽约市府初步胜诉
local.s: 房东联盟起诉市长马姆达尼的两年租金冻结政策，史坦顿岛州高等法院法官21日作出初步裁决，市府先胜一局。案件仍在继续。

local.t: 布碌崙八大道将增百余个垃圾桶，整治脏乱
local.s: 市议员庄文怡邀请市清洁局局长视察八大道，清洁局将在当地增设一百多个垃圾桶，回应华社长期反映的卫生与摊贩问题。

immigration.t: H-1B新规密集出台：配偶工卡自动延期取消，60天宽限期拟废除
immigration.s: 国土安全部10月取消H-1B配偶（H-4）工作许可的自动延期，并考虑取消其工作资格；9月提议废除工作结束后的60天宽限期，同时拟取消续签时对过往批准的“尊重”原则。持H-1B的华人家庭应尽早与律师规划续签时间。

immigration.t: H-1B拟收10.3万元新费用，公众意见征询11月13日截止
immigration.s: 国土安全部提议对受名额限制的H-1B申请收取10万3265元，包括F-1学生转H-1B。另一项去年9月起针对新H-1B的10万元费用目前被法院阻挡，案件在上诉中。60天宽限期提案的意见征询则于11月10日截止。

immigration.t: 劳工部称将严查H-1B与J-1签证欺诈，暂无新限制
immigration.s: 劳工部监察长10月22日表示正与白宫反欺诈小组合作，追查涉嫌违规的H-1B与J-1个案。不过官方目前并未宣布新的调查、执法行动或签证限制。

uschina.t: 美国更新中国旅行警告：提醒华裔美国公民注意被拘留及出境禁令风险
uschina.s: 国务院本周维持中国大陆二级“提高警惕”警告，并新增任意拘留与出境禁令的提醒，指出中方可能针对华裔美国公民及涉商业纠纷者。计划回国探亲或出差的华人请先阅读最新警告。

uschina.t: 中美互降约300亿元商品关税，玩具小家电或降价
uschina.s: 川习会后，中美计划各自对约300亿美元进口商品降税。美方降税涵盖玩具、小家电和家居用品，中方则调降多项农产品关税。分析人士认为贸易休战仍属脆弱。

uschina.t: 美国制裁5家中国实体，涉前谷歌工程师窃取AI机密案
uschina.s: 美方制裁包括前谷歌工程师丁林伟创办的上海公司在内的5家实体。丁林伟今年1月在旧金山被联邦陪审团裁定窃取美国公司AI商业机密罪成。

uschina.t: 明州玉米田惊现约3米长火箭残骸，疑来自中国商业火箭
uschina.s: 明尼苏达州一名农民10月14日在玉米田发现不明金属物体，专家认为它极可能是中国朱雀二号E火箭的残骸。所幸无人受伤。

china.t: 西藏发生7级地震，至少16人遇难
china.s: 据中国官媒报道，西藏发生7级地震，造成至少16人死亡、数十人受伤。有亲友在当地的读者可留意官方最新通报。

china.t: 中共二十届五中全会10月26日至29日召开
china.s: 习近平周五主持政治局会议，为下周召开的五中全会做准备。外界预期此次会议将带来近年规模最大的人事调整之一。

top.t: New York early voting starts today and runs through Nov. 1
top.s: Early voting for the Nov. 3 midterm election runs Oct. 24 through Nov. 1. NYC voters are assigned one early voting site, which may differ from their Election Day poll site, so check the Board of Elections site before going. Anyone who votes early cannot vote again on Election Day.
top.src: New York State Board of Elections

top.t: FBI-led raids hit 100+ NYC adult day care centers; Flushing at the center
top.s: Federal, state and city agents searched social adult day care centers across Queens, Brooklyn and Staten Island on Oct. 20 in a Medicaid fraud probe. The FBI says New York Medicaid paid about $2.4 billion for these services from January 2019 to October 2024. CMS chief Mehmet Oz delivered warning letters to two Flushing centers in person.

top.t: Wider SNAP work rules put some Chinese families' benefits at risk
top.s: United Way of NYC warns that expanded SNAP work rules require some recipients aged 18 to 64 to show 80 hours a month of work, training or volunteering or risk losing benefits. Anyone who gets a notice should contact their local social services office or a SNAP navigator.

local.t: City wins first round in landlords' rent-freeze lawsuit
local.s: A state judge on Staten Island ruled for the city on Oct. 21 in a preliminary decision on landlords' challenge to Mayor Mamdani's two-year rent freeze. The case continues.

local.t: Brooklyn's Eighth Avenue to get 100+ new trash cans
local.s: Council Member Susan Zhuang toured Eighth Avenue with the Sanitation commissioner, who committed to adding more than 100 litter baskets to address long-running cleanliness complaints.

immigration.t: H-1B rule changes pile up: spouses lose automatic work-permit extensions
immigration.s: In October DHS ended automatic extensions of work authorization for H-1B spouses and is weighing removing their eligibility altogether. It has also proposed scrapping the 60-day grace period after a job ends and dropping deference to prior approvals on extensions. Families on H-1B should plan renewals early with an attorney.

immigration.t: Proposed $103,265 H-1B fee open for comment until Nov. 13
immigration.s: DHS has proposed a $103,265 fee on cap-subject H-1B petitions, including F-1 to H-1B changes of status. A separate $100,000 fee from September 2025 is blocked in court while on appeal. Comments on the grace-period proposal close Nov. 10.

immigration.t: Labor Department vows tougher look at H-1B and J-1 fraud
immigration.s: The Labor Department's inspector general said on Oct. 22 his office is working with the White House fraud task force to pursue suspected H-1B and J-1 violations. No new investigation, enforcement action or visa restriction has been announced.

uschina.t: Updated China travel advisory warns of detention and exit bans
uschina.s: The State Department kept mainland China at Level 2 "Exercise Increased Caution" this week and added warnings on wrongful detention and exit bans. It says Chinese authorities may target U.S. citizens of Chinese heritage and people in business disputes. Read it before traveling.

uschina.t: US and China cut tariffs on about $30 billion of goods each
uschina.s: After the Trump-Xi summit, each side plans tariff cuts on roughly $30 billion of imports. U.S. cuts cover toys, small appliances and household goods; China is trimming duties on farm products. Analysts call the truce fragile.

uschina.t: US sanctions 5 Chinese entities over ex-Google engineer's AI theft
uschina.s: The sanctioned firms include a Shanghai company founded by former Google engineer Ding Linwei, who was convicted by a San Francisco federal jury in January of stealing AI trade secrets.

uschina.t: 11-foot rocket chunk found in Minnesota cornfield, likely Chinese
uschina.s: A Minnesota farmer reported metal debris in his cornfield on Oct. 14. Experts say it almost certainly came from a Chinese Zhuque-2E rocket. No one was hurt.

china.t: Magnitude-7 earthquake in Tibet kills at least 16
china.s: Chinese state media report a magnitude-7 quake in Tibet that killed at least 16 people and injured dozens.

china.t: Communist Party's fifth plenum to meet Oct. 26–29
china.s: Xi Jinping chaired a Politburo meeting on Friday ahead of the plenum, which observers expect to bring one of the largest personnel turnovers in recent years.
